name: ZEDONE BS6 Luxury Bus Mod
shortDescription: New ZEDONE BS6 Luxury tourist bus mod for Bus Simulator Indonesia featuring ultra-realistic interior, smooth driving, and animated features.
description: Get behind the wheel of the all-new ZEDONE BS6 Luxury Bus in Bus Simulator Indonesia. Built with high-detail 3D exterior modeling, custom Kerala tourist bus paint scheme, rooftop auxiliary fog lamps, full passenger cabin interior with LED lighting, interactive door animations, realistic physics, and smooth highway handling.
author: VayZenXPlayz
features: Ultra-detailed real interior cabin & passenger seats
Smooth high-speed driving physics & realistic steering
High quality 3D mesh with rooftop auxiliary spotlights
Crisp Kerala tourist bus livery with custom stickers
Realistic diesel turbo whistle and air brake sound
requirements: Bus Simulator Indonesia v4.0.4 or higher installed
50MB free storage space for mod extraction

installationGuide.title: Download Mod File
installationGuide.instruction: Click the Download button below to unlock and download your ZEDONE BS6 Bus mod file.

installationGuide.title: Move to BUSSID/Mods Directory
installationGuide.instruction: Open ZArchiver or your file manager, locate the downloaded file, and move it to: Internal Storage > BUSSID > Mods.

installationGuide.title: Activate in BUSSID Garage
installationGuide.instruction: Launch Bus Simulator Indonesia, open Garage (Garasi), navigate to the ZEDONE BS6 Luxury Bus and tap 'Use' (Pakai)!

name: BHARATBENZ GLIDER Z+ BS6 Luxury Coach
shortDescription: Official BharatBenz Glider Z+ BS6 Oneness luxury bus mod for Bus Simulator Indonesia with realistic engine sounds and animated doors.
description: Experience the superior engineering of the BharatBenz Glider Z+ BS6 Luxury Tourist Coach in Bus Simulator Indonesia. Features realistic BharatBenz heavy diesel engine sounds, working air suspension, full 3-button animations (passenger doors, luggage compartment, driver cabin window), custom LED lighting, Oneness liveries, and high-speed gearing for national highway cruising.
author: VayZenXPlayz
features: Authentic BharatBenz BS6 diesel engine sound loops
HD 4K interior passenger cabin with reading lamps
Realistic air brake hiss & reverse warning alarm
High-speed highway gear ratio & smooth air ride
requirements: Bus Simulator Indonesia version 4.0.4 or higher installed
40MB free storage space for mod & livery files

installationGuide.title: Download the Mod File

installationGuide.title: Move to BUSSID/Mods Directory
